About Our Mattress Cleaning Service

A mattress collects sweat, dust and dead skin every night, and it's almost impossible to clean one properly at home. Cleanzit offers mattress cleaning at your home, and full dry cleaning for single and double mattresses.

At-home mattress cleaning starts at ₹399. Mattress dry cleaning is ₹599 for a single and ₹799 for a double.

Mattress care tips

  • Use a washable mattress protector — it's far easier to clean than the mattress.
  • Rotate the mattress every few months so it wears evenly.
  • Air the room and let the mattress breathe when you change sheets.
